classification: descriptive managed PPTX cache, budget, source-read and process-RSS phase observations
production_change: Additive fallible diagnostic forwarding on existing PPTX source owners; no workload optimization.
capture_constraints: Freeze protocol, harness and independent report verifier before release build and formal capture.
Reuse exact prior plain/media-rich PPTX corpus builders and independently validated exact output/media oracles. Record finite context/cache limits and deterministic calibration inputs.
Use separate caller-owned source/destination execution contexts. Keep them alive to observe budgets after package owners drop without retaining extra cache or package owners.

Source-backed publication consumes the destination editor. Its cache becomes unavailable; final source-cache diagnostics likewise become unavailable after its last owner drops. Never fabricate zero snapshots.
Read cache snapshots through try_cache_diagnostics, validate event intervals through checked_counter_delta, and retain all cache gauges separately.
Memory and object reservation usage are releasable gauges; InputBytes, OutputBytes and Work are cumulative charges and must not be asserted zero after drop.
RSS and VmHWM are process points containing corpus/runtime/observer state; sampling includes procfs overhead. They are not object-owned bytes or cache budget.
Exact/one-under image admission applies to the preprimed selected image request; record zero source-read/output on promised memory refusal.

Selected-image Memory cap equals same-policy calibrated pinned-root Memory plus declared payload bytes (one-under subtracts one). Record primed metadata separately: reservation retry can evict unpinned metadata, so it is not part of the irreducible admission floor.
Pinning/eviction and oversized bypass retain actual image handles and report their budget effects; cache capacity and caller-held uncached reservations have distinct scopes.

Repeated publication exercises three successes at an exact cumulative output-byte ceiling; any additional refusal must preserve its typed error and actual accepted output. Do not call this a measured exact peak-memory ceiling.
Root serializes all builds/tests/analysis/capture workloads; agents perform source-only work. Host background activity is uncontrolled.
Retain all raw samples and failures. Review repeat drift >5% per comparable nonzero gauge, every release invariant violation, and RSS noise without claiming causality.
Portable replay and adversarial mutations must pass after task-temporary executable cleanup.
scope_limits: No latency, throughput, allocator callback, physical-copy, general leak, or causal optimization claim.
Fixed synthetic in-memory PPTX corpora; native/cold/range sources and broader CRUD/scaling/streaming remain open.
Selected-image near-memory limits and repeated cumulative-output limits do not certify every cross-copy transient or global allocation is budget charged.
